name: Pouncing Tiger Haunt AP OLD
description: A cave painting of a great cat roars to life and leaps off the wall to attack.
disable: DC 18 Nature (trained) or DC 18 Religion (trained) to quell the spirit
reset: If the cave painting isn't destroyed, the haunt resets after 1 day.

generalAbilities.name: Tiger Slash
generalAbilities.description:
Trigger A living creature approaches within 5 feet of the cave painting

Effect The haunt deals 4d8 Slashing Damage damage with semisolid claws (Basic DC 18 Will Saving Throw). On a failed save, the target is also Frightened 1 and Fleeing for 1 round (or Frightened 2 and fleeing for 1 minute on a critical failure).
